text:
Maya: Quick sync  Were onboarding AcmeAI to AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Primary asks: publisher identity proofing, KMS ownership model, trial SKU mapping across clouds, and whether provider UI supports vendor-handled seat trials.
Jared: Legal note  if Acme keeps KMS, we need a narrow MOI + append to contract around key access and telemetry. I'll start draft. Any requirements from product/eng to feed into the addendum?
Anika: Product: they want a 14-day trial, 5 seats, token metering. Prefer marketplace-native trial if possible. If not, we'll publish "trial via vendor" and map SKU -> entitlement on our side.
Samir: Engineering checklist: AWS needs publisher IAM ARN + key alias; GCP needs publisher project ID and KMS resource name; Azure needs tenant id + managed identity for our marketplace bridge. If they can't provide, we can host keys in our VPC but that changes compliance posture.
Devon: Ops: Azure offer requires offerId + plan slug early. I can scaffold the offer once we have tenant/publisher. Also need billing contact from Acme for marketplace payout wiring.
Maya: Acme verbally agreed to supply IAM/KMS artifacts by Tue EOD. Jared, can legal turn around an addendum draft by Mon?
Jared: Yes, I'll aim for Mon COB. I'll include a clause for trial auto-conversion opt-out and a KMS access narrow-scope policy.
Samir: Sharing a minimal AWS role template they can create (paste as-is):
```
# AWS role for cross-account KMS access
RoleName: RedwoodMarketplaceBridge_AcmeAI
AssumeRolePolicyDocument: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDBOX:root"}, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"}]}
InlinePolicy: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACMEID:key/ACME-ALIAS*"]}]}
```
Samir: For GCP we prefer a service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific key.
Anika: Two UX signals: marketplace listing text must clearly state "trial limits handled by vendor" if we manage entitlements, and we should include a link to the SKU entitlement table. I'll prepare copy.
Devon: Ops automation note: if keys are external we need a read-only telemetry role that only allows DescribeKey and Encrypt/Decrypt as scoped. Also ensure we rotate any short-term creds.
Maya: Risk check  any blockers for Acme-hosted keys from eng/security?
Samir: Security flagged one item  cross-account KMS policies must be auditable. We'll require Acme to provide key policy and list of principals. Also GCP key region caveat: key location must match publisher project region for marketplace acceptance - told Acme to verify.
Jared: Also calling out tax/payout: some marketplaces will require a publisher legal entity verified. If Acme is listing under Redwood's publisher account temporarily, we need reseller paperwork. Can Ops confirm whether we want them under our publisher or as third-party?
Devon: Ops prefers third-party publisher so revenue flows direct to Acme. If they insist on Redwood as publisher, we'd need a reseller agreement + tax docs.
Maya: Action items: 1) Acme to send IAM/KMS + billing contact by Tue EOD; 2) Jared to draft KMS/entitlement addendum by Mon; 3) Anika will draft listing copy and SKU mapping; 4) Devon to scaffold Azure offer and payout steps; 5) Samir to validate role/snippets and infra caveats. ops-bot: create checklist?
ops-bot: Created checklist -> /internal/marketplace/onboards/AcmeAI-1715678901 (owners: Maya, Devon) :white_check_mark:
Jared: I'll add a short appendix for trial auto-convert and refund window.
Anika: If the marketplaces don't support 5-seat trials natively, we'll publish a single "trial" SKU and implement seat enforcement server-side. I'll report back by Monday.
Samir: I'll also add a small script template for validating cross-account KMS access during onboarding.
Maya: Solid  thanks all. We'll reconvene Tue 10am PT to confirm artifacts.
